title: no-op property-redefinition census
purpose: decide whether the same-flags shape-uniquing cut precedes the P7-41 builtin bridge; not a re-validation of the mechanism

spec_corrections.claim: bucket B "unique hashed + same flags -> removeShapeHash" occurs in replaceProperty
spec_corrections.detail: replaceProperty calls Object.ensureUniqueShapeForMutation (object.zig:11309), which is NOT shape.Registry.prepareUpdate (shape.zig:420). It has no removeShapeHash arm: it early-returns whenever refCount()==1 and otherwise clones. Only bucket A (shared shape) and bucket C (rc==1, early return) can occur.

spec_corrections.claim: the cut must gate updatePropertyFlags as well
spec_corrections.finding: that second gate is redundant, though harmless
spec_corrections.detail: shape.Registry.updatePropertyFlags already early-returns on identical flags (shape.zig:578).

groups: wrapped(same-runtime closure matrix, builtin bridge cases, P0 sentinels)
corpus.note: counting only; no exclusive measurement lock taken

gbemu.note: cost per event is the NamedEvaluation figure from P7-50 and is the most expensive class

B_unique_hashed_same_flags.reason: no removeShapeHash arm on this path

C_unique_unhashed_same_flags.note: rc==1 never observed with same flags in this corpus; would be near-free anyway

two_unrelated_workloads.why: both high-count entries are the same P7-50 synthetic NamedEvaluation shape

absolute_total_beats_bridge.why: 6 events across the other 170 corpus entries; 21 in a whole gbemu run

high_frequency_path_outside_named_evalua.why: the var-ref branch never fired anywhere in the corpus

verdict: defer: legitimate qjs-alignment cleanup, but not the current largest item; do P7-42 builtin bridge phase attribution first
